name: Masquerade Ball
description: A high society gala where masked revelers trade secrets and favors.

features.name: Costumes Required
features.description: Everyone at the ball is expected to arrive in costume. PCs have advantage on Presence Rolls to convince others they are someone—or something—they’re not.
features.prompt: What do the PCs come dressed as? What do their costumes reveal about their true selves?

features.name: “Care to Dance?”
features.description: While dancing, a PC can make an Agility Roll instead of a Presence Roll to influence others. What’s notable or unique about the dances that are in fashion here?
features.prompt: Where did the PCs learn how to perform them?

features.name: Mistaken Identity
features.description: A very important person confuses a PC with an even more important person. The target can play into the misunderstanding with a Presence Reaction Roll. On a success, the PC can ask the VIP to perform a favor, relay a key piece of information, or make an introduction. On a failure, the PC marks a Stress as their true identity is discovered, and they are threatened with ejection from the party.
features.prompt: Who does the VIP mistake them for? What doors does their mistake open? What dangers does it bring?

features.name: Cloak and Dagger
features.description: Spend a Fear to have an operative try to steal something valuable or assassinate someone important. A PC can make an Instinct Roll to try to notice them before they achieve their objective. On a success, the PC gains the opportunity to intervene. On a failure with Fear, the PC is erroneously implicated in the crime.
features.prompt: Who does the operative work for? Why did they send them to the masquerade?
